d: Nestled in the picturesque state of Meghalaya, Mawlynnong is a quaint village that sets an inspiring example in cleanliness and environmental consciousness. Each of the homes in this village is equipped with a toilet. To further its commitment to cleanliness, bamboo waste baskets are strategically placed along every road, ensuring that littering is virtually non-existent. Moreover, the village's educational system plays a pivotal role in ingraining the ethos of cleanliness in its young inhabitants; children as young as four are taught the importance of maintaining a clean environment.
